newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 9-mo c/a deficit $3.1 bln (-$579.6 mln). [CORRECTED 15:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Czech 9-mo c/a deficit $3.1 bln (-$579.6 mln). [CORRECTED 15:10 GMT]

text.p: The Czech current account deficit for the first nine months of the year rose to $3.1 billion compared with a deficit of $579.6 million for the first three quarters of 1995, the Czech National Bank said on Thursday.

In a statement the central bank said the net capital account inflow totalled 55 billion Czech crowns for the nine-month period while outflow totalled 24.5 billion crowns, implying a capital account surplus of 30.5 billion crowns.
(Corrects to show capital account inflow is net, not gross.)
The CNB did not provide a relevant dollar figure for the capital account.
